attribution.note: Zitron expressly endorses the comparison in his own words.

semantics.note: The proposition captures a contemporaneous spread comparison, not a formal credit downgrade.

contract.note: The surrounding text expressly names average OAS and the broad high-yield index. Requiring comparable data near publication fairly implements that comparison.

evidence.note: Accurately presented, dated reporting provides relevant background. Its early-July credit spreads and BB-only benchmark cannot establish or contradict the near-publication comparison with broad high-yield OAS.

reviews.rationale: The packet lacks matched SpaceX and broad high-yield OAS data near July 28. Earlier reporting uses a different benchmark and spread measure. It neither settles the stated comparison nor disproves it; Zitron's own figures cannot independently substantiate his claim.
